_comment: Calculation options of the strengths, chakra and calculation menus (tests/calcOptions.test.ts skips while the output is absent). One run per variant, each into golden/jhora-calc-options/<variant>/ with capture.py --ini overrides; restore the copy's jhcore/jhora.ini (golden/jhora-defaults.ini) afterwards - JHora saves its options on exit. capture.py --ini replaces every line of an array key, so AshtakaVargaCalculation=<slot> <0|1> sets one flag per run. Variants: default (no --ini; also the Nisheka chart of 33291 and the 'Nakshatras & rasis from sodhya pindas' drawing); amsa-swarudha1 (SwarudhaInAmsaBala=1); amsa-swarudha4 (SwarudhaInAmsaBala=4); amsa-swarudha7-disp (SwarudhaInAmsaBala=7, DispositorCombustionBadInAmsaBala=1, DispositorDefeatBadInAmsaBala=1, DispositorNeechaBadInAmsaBala=1, DispositorNeechaRasiBadInAmsaBala=1, DispositorPoorVimsopakaBadInAmsaBala=1, DispositorSayanadiBadInAmsaBala=1); avastha-compound (UseCompundRelationshipInAvasthas=1); avastha-compound-rasi (UseCompundRelationshipInAvasthas=1, CompoundRelationshipsFromRasi=1); av-reversed (AshtakaVargaDefinition=0); av-bhava-eight (BhavaDrivenSarvaAshtakaVarga=1, EightAVInSAV=1); av-flag1 (AshtakaVargaCalculation=1 0); refraction (ApparentRefraction=1); upagraha-eighth-lmt (MandiInSaturnPortion=0, GulikaInSaturnPortion=0, UpagrahaDayDefinition=1); continuous-lagnas (ContinuousSpecialLagnas=1); mb-pd-start (MBTablePreference=1, MBLocationPreference=0); pushkara-patel (PushkaraBhagaJP=0); nodes-parasara (NodalExaltationParasara=1); arudha-longitude (LongitudeBasedBhavaArudhas=1, ArudhaBasePlanet=2); arudha-divlongs (LongitudeBasedBhavaArudhas=1, DivLongsInBhavaArudhas=1); tropical-sidereal-naks (UserSelectedAyanamsa=16, SiderealNaksharasInTropical=1). Not fillable by the harness (dialogs): the avastha varga (33046), the house reference longitude (33248), the Sarvatobhadra special points (dialogs 2016-2019, 2058) - capture those by hand (screenshots) if needed.
